mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies at Reddan Soccer Park and the moon is currently in its first quarter phase, though we have no visible ISS passes tonight.

The city channel VHAT is your go-to for local government meetings and public information, while the city also reminds residents to follow parking codes for vehicles and explore composting options at the Food Scrap Stop.
There is plenty to do with the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market and trivia at The Bogey Factory today, plus Concerts in the Park are coming up tomorrow.
On July 15, officers arrested a local man for felony bail jumping following a domestic disturbance call on Prairie Oaks Drive.
Mint Explosion is today's flavor of the day. The store is currently closed but will reopen at 10:00 AM, so head over then to grab your treat.
